description: Per-player turn file (the .m equivalent) returned by GET /games/{game-id}/turns/{year}/players/{player-id}. The engine derives this from its host-side ground truth via a single choke point so no host-only data leaks. See stars-reborn-design/docs/architecture.rst (Per-Player Visibility).

planet-unobserved.description: A planet the player has never observed. Only identity (id, name, position) is known — these come from the shared .xy data. No contents fields appear.
planet-unobserved.title: PlanetUnobserved

planet-observed.description: A planet the player has observed. Contents fields hold values as of the last scan; years-since-last-scan = 0 means current ground truth, anything higher is stale (see Information Staleness in stars-reborn-design/docs/mechanics/scanning.rst).

years-since-last-scan.description: 0 = currently in penetrating-scan range (or owned). Higher = stale snapshot.

temperature.description: Temperature in °C, snapped to 4° steps in [-200, 200].

owner.description: Player id of the current owner. Absent ⇒ observed but unowned (e.g. abandoned colony).

value.description: Planet value computed against the viewing player's race. 0..100 = habitable; negative = red (capped at -45). Different players see different values for the same planet.

resources-per-year.description: Resources the planet generates per year: floor(population / resource-production) + operated-factories x factory-production (see docs/mechanics/production.rst). A derived value recomputed each turn, present only for a planet the viewing player owns. Absent when the engine cannot compute it (e.g. an Alternate Reality race, whose economy model is not yet implemented).

scanner-type.description: Display name of the planet's effective planetary scanner — the best planetary scanner the owner has researched (empire-wide, automatic; see docs/mechanics/scanning.rst). Present only for an owned planet; absent for an Alternate Reality race (no planetary scanners) and when the race is unknown. Does NOT yet fold in an orbiting starbase's scanner (future work).

scanner-range.description: Normal scan range in light-years of the planet's effective planetary scanner. Present under the same conditions as scanner-type.

defenses.description: Number of planetary defense installations on this planet (0..100). Present only for an owned planet. 0 until defenses production lands.

defense-type.description: Display name of the defense TYPE built here — the best planetary defense the owner has researched (all of a planet's defenses are that type). Present only for an owned planet; absent when the race is unknown.

defense-coverage.description: Overall colonist protection as an integer percent (0..100): 1 − (1 − base_coverage)^defenses, where base_coverage is the per-defense kill probability of defense-type (docs/reference/planetary_tech.rst). 0 when there are no defenses. Present only for an owned planet. Exact value pending oracle verification.

build-queue.description: The planet's production queue, in build order. Present only for planets the viewing player owns (production is private); empty array when the queue is empty.

route-target.description: Planet id this owned planet routes arriving fleets to (the "Route To" destination), or null for no route. Present only for owned planets, since routing is private to the owner.

starbase.description: This planet's starbase display stats, present only when the planet has a starbase. Derived from the owner's starbase design (hull + installed components); see docs/mechanics/starbase_design.rst. Absent when the planet has no starbase.

planet-observed.title: PlanetObserved

starbase-status.description: Aggregated display stats for a planet's starbase, derived from its design (hull + installed components).

dock-capacity.description: Maximum mass (kT) of a ship this starbase can build or repair: 0 = cannot build/repair (Orbital Fort), a finite value, or null for unlimited (Space Station and larger).

armor.description: Total armor damage-points (hull base armor plus armor contributed by installed components).

shields.description: Total shield damage-points from installed shield (and shield-bearing armor) components.

damage-percent.description: Battle damage as a percent 0-100; 0 for an undamaged starbase. (Battle damage is not modelled yet, so currently always 0.)

mass-driver.description: Launch warp (5-13) of the installed mass driver, or null if none is installed.

packet-target.description: Planet id this starbase's mineral packets are launched toward, or null if no target is set.

starbase-status.title: StarbaseStatus

build-item.description: One entry in an owned planet's production queue. build-object-id indexes the buildable registry (GET /model/buildables): 7=factory, 8=mine, 9=defenses, 1024+N=design slot N. See docs/mechanics/production.rst.

build-quantity.description: Number of this item remaining to build.

build-progress.description: Percent complete (0..99) of the item at the head of this entry; 0 for a freshly queued item.

estimated-years-to-complete.description: Projected years to finish this entry at the planet's current output. Absent until the cost/output model lands.

build-item.title: BuildItem

slot-assignment.description: One filled hull slot in a ship design: which component sits in which slot, and how many.

slot-index.description: Index into the hull's slots array (GET /model/ships/hulls). Identifies which physical slot is filled.

part-id.description: Component installed in this slot; indexes the technology catalog (GET /model/technologies).

count.description: How many of the part occupy this slot; bounded by the hull slot's max-count.

slot-assignment.title: SlotAssignment

ship-design.description: A ship or starbase design owned by the viewing player. Drives the Ship Designer Existing Designs view and the production queue (a build-item with build-object-id 1024+slot refers to the ship design in that slot). See docs/mechanics/ship_design.rst.

slot.description: Design slot index. Ship designs occupy slots 0-15, starbase designs 0-9 in a parallel space (disambiguated by kind). Production queue items reference a ship design as build-object-id 1024+slot.

kind.description: Whether this is a ship or a starbase design; selects whether hull-id is a ship-hull or starbase-hull id.

name.description: Player-assigned design name shown in the Existing Designs list.

hull-id.description: Hull this design is built on. A ship-hull id (GET /model/ships/hulls) when kind=ship, a starbase-hull id when kind=starbase.

slot-assignments.description: Filled slots. Empty slots are omitted. A complete ship design fills at least its required engine slot.

built-count.description: Number of ships of this design currently in existence across the player's fleets. Drives the 'N of N' badge; when > 0 the design cannot be edited (its slot is locked until the last ship is gone).

ship-design.title: ShipDesign

scanned-design.description: An enemy (or other-player) ship/starbase design the viewing player has learned about by scanning a fleet built from it, or from meeting it in battle. Partial information, gated by scan depth (see docs/mechanics/scanning.rst 'Enemy Design Intel'): identity fields (owner, name, hull, kind) are known from any observation; the component fill (slot-assignments) is known only from a penetrating-range scan and is omitted otherwise. Like planet intel, the fields hold the values as of the last observation; years-since-last-scan = 0 means seen this turn, higher is a stale snapshot. Drives the Ship Designer 'Enemy Hulls' view and battle planning. Empty until the engine models fleets and scanning.

owner-player-id.description: Player id of the design's owner (the scanned enemy), distinguishing designs that collide on slot/name across players.

design-slot.description: The owner's design slot index (ship 0-15, starbase 0-9). With owner-player-id it is the stable identity of the enemy design, so a re-scan updates the same record rather than adding a duplicate.

kind.description: Whether this is a ship or a starbase design; selects whether hull-id is a ship-hull or starbase-hull id.

name.description: The owner's name for the design, as revealed by scanning. Basic (normal-range) intel.

hull-id.description: Hull the design is built on: a ship-hull id (GET /model/ships/hulls) when kind=ship, a starbase-hull id when kind=starbase. Identifiable from a scanned fleet, so basic (normal-range) intel.

years-since-last-scan.description: 0 = observed this turn (current composition). Higher = a stale snapshot from an earlier observation; the owner may have since redesigned the slot (designs are mutable while unbuilt).

slot-assignments.description: The design's component fill, same shape as a player's own design. Present only when the player has penetrating-range intel on a fleet of this design; omitted (not empty) when only basic intel is held. NAS races never obtain it by scanning. Needs oracle verification — see docs/mechanics/scanning.rst.

scanned-design.title: ScannedDesign

planet-intel.description: A single planet entry in the player's turn file. Untagged on the wire: clients distinguish observed vs. unobserved by the presence of contents fields.
planet-intel.title: PlanetIntel

fleet.description: One of the viewing player's own fleets, in full. A fleet is a named group of ships at a map location with an ordered waypoint list. Its id shares the universe-wide space-object id space with planets, so it is a valid 'Goto' / related-object subject. Only the player's OWN fleets appear here; other players' fleets detected by scanning appear in scanned-fleets with partial info. See docs/gameplay/fleets.rst.

id.description: Universe-wide space-object id, unique across every planet and fleet.

owner.description: Owning player id (always the viewing player for an own fleet; present for uniformity with scanned-fleets).

orbiting-planet-id.description: Planet id this fleet orbits. Absent when the fleet is in deep space; when present, (x, y) equals that planet's position.

ship-stacks.description: Ship composition: one entry per ship design the fleet contains, with how many ships of that design.

fuel.description: Fuel on board (mg), shared across the whole fleet.

waypoints.description: Ordered list of future destinations, each with a travel warp and an order to run on arrival. Empty for an idle fleet. The fleet's current position is (x, y), not a waypoint.

repeat-orders.description: When true the waypoint chain cycles back to the first waypoint after the last waypoint's order runs (automated freighter loops).

fleet.title: Fleet

ship-stack.description: A group of identical ships in a fleet: `count` ships built from the owner's ship design in slot `design-slot`.

design-slot.description: The owner's ship-design slot (0-15) these ships are built from. For an own fleet it indexes the player's own ship-designs.

count.description: Number of ships of this design in the fleet.

ship-stack.title: ShipStack

fleet-cargo.description: Minerals and colonists carried by a fleet, in kT.
fleet-cargo.title: FleetCargo

fleet-waypoint.description: One destination in a fleet's route: where to go, how fast, and what to do on arrival. See docs/mechanics/fleet_movement.rst 'Waypoints'.

target-planet-id.description: Planet id this waypoint targets, when the destination is a planet (its position equals x, y). Absent for a bare-coordinate waypoint.

warp.description: Warp speed to travel to this waypoint (0-10; 10 is the ramscoop free 'safe speed'). Distance covered is warp-squared ly per year.

fleet-waypoint.title: FleetWaypoint

fleet-waypoint-task.description: Order a fleet runs on reaching a waypoint. See docs/mechanics/fleet_movement.rst 'Waypoint orders'.
fleet-waypoint-task.title: FleetWaypointTask

scanned-fleet.description: Another player's fleet the viewing player has detected within scanner coverage. Partial and scan-depth gated: position and owner are known from any detection; the exact ship composition is never exposed here (only an aggregate ship-count, when the scan is close enough). Like planet and design intel, fields hold the values as of the last scan; years-since-last-scan = 0 means detected this turn, higher is a stale snapshot. Empty until the engine models fleet scanning — the growth point that mirrors the planet observed/unobserved split (game/view.rs). See docs/mechanics/scanning.rst.

id.description: Universe-wide space-object id of the detected fleet.

owner-player-id.description: Player id that owns the detected fleet.

orbiting-planet-id.description: Planet id the detected fleet orbits, when known. Absent in deep space.

name.description: The owner's fleet name, when revealed by the scan. Absent at coarse scan depth.

ship-count.description: Aggregate number of ships in the detected fleet, when the scan is close enough to count them. Absent otherwise. The per-design breakdown is never exposed.

years-since-last-scan.description: 0 = detected this turn (current). Higher = a stale snapshot from an earlier detection.

scanned-fleet.title: ScannedFleet

turn-message.description: One message shown in the player's turn for this year. Messages are per-turn (regenerated each year, not accumulated). Mirrors the design-target turn-message shape in schemas/turn.json.

id.description: Position of this message within this turn's list, 0-based. Stable only within the turn file it appears in.

message.description: The rendered display text. The original client caps a single message at 1024 characters; the engine keeps messages well under that.

message-type.description: Stable tag for the kind of message (the turn-message-type family in schemas/turn.json), e.g. 'PlanetProductionQueueEmpty'. A client treats it as an opaque tag and never derives importance from it.

related-object.description: Universe-wide space-object id (a planet or fleet) this message is about — the client's 'Goto' subject. Absent for a message with no on-map subject.

related-battle.description: Id of the battle this message reports on, when it is a combat message. Absent otherwise.

important.description: Whether this message survives the player's 'hide unimportant messages' filter. The engine classifies importance; a client never derives it from message-type.

turn-message.title: TurnMessage

turn-score.description: The viewing player's F10 score breakdown for this year (see docs/mechanics/victory.rst). Own score only; opponents' scores and ranks are gated on the public-player-scores game flag, which is not modelled yet. Each category carries its raw count and the points it contributes; `total` is their sum. The ship categories read 0 until ship combat-power classification lands (the fleet model exists, but a ship's power rating is a combat-model concern).

total.description: Total F10 score: the sum of every category's points.

planet-count.description: Number of planets the player owns.

starbase-count.description: Starbases owned (Orbital Forts excluded). 0 until starbase score-counting lands.

unarmed-count.description: Unarmed ships (power rating 0). 0 until ship combat-power classification lands.

escort-count.description: Escort ships (power rating 1..1999). 0 until ship combat-power classification lands.

capital-count.description: Capital ships (power rating >= 2000). 0 until ship combat-power classification lands.

tech-level-sum.description: Sum of the player's six tech-field levels.

resource-amount.description: Annual resources the player's planets generate.

turn-score.title: TurnScore

game-id.description: UUID v4 string identifying the game.

homeworld-id.description: Planet id of the viewing player's homeworld. Absent if the player has no homeworld (e.g. eliminated).

planets.description: Every planet in the universe, sorted by id. Each entry is either observed (full contents) or unobserved (identity only).

fleets.description: The viewing player's own fleets, each in full. Always the player's own fleets (never another player's), mirroring ship-designs. Empty when the player has no fleets. Sorted by fleet id.

scanned-fleets.description: Other players' fleets this player has detected within scanner coverage (partial info; see the scanned-fleet definition). Never includes the viewing player's own fleets. Empty until the engine models fleet scanning.

ship-designs.description: The viewing player's own ship and starbase designs. Always the player's own designs (never another player's). Empty until the engine models designs.

scanned-designs.description: Other players' ship/starbase designs this player has learned about through scanning or battle (partial info, see the scanned-design definition). Never includes the viewing player's own designs. Empty until the engine models fleets and scanning.

messages.description: This player's messages for this turn, in display order. Per-turn: regenerated every year, never accumulated. Carries only messages the engine can produce from the state it models today (e.g. an empty production queue); event messages (combat, bombing, colonisation, growth, mining, research, minefields, packets, random events) are added as turn resolution and each mechanic land.

race.description: The viewing player's own race (PRT, LRTs, hab preferences, economy, research costs). Always the player's own race, never another player's. Absent only when the player has no race (e.g. a phantom/unknown player id).

title: PlayerView
